subject: Insurance
title: Insurable Interest
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Insurable Interest.

hook.text: You can't insure your neighbor's house. You need 'insurable interest'—a financial stake in what you're insuring.

buildup.text: The rule dates to the 1774 Life Assurance Act.

discovery.text: You have insurable interest in your own life, your spouse's, your business partner's, and your property.

twist.text: Corporations insured janitors without their knowledge—'dead peasant' policies.

climax.text: Insurable interest separates insurance from gambling.

quiz.question: What is insurable interest?
options: A financial stake in the insured item or person
